up: Open the door, walk out, the hinges were never locked.
The cycle spins whether you feed it or not. Step off anyway.
Some cages are just weather and habit sharing a room.
You keep doing the thing that stops the feeling. Tonight, stop the doing.
The loop has a door. It is embarrassing how door-shaped it is.
Name the habit out loud and watch its budget shrink.
Walk past the thing once without it. The craving files a complaint, briefly.
What would you want if you were not needing this.
rev: The cuffs are on, voluntarily, and you kept the only key.
Back again, and the story about last time got longer.
Any time now is a real policy with a long trading history.
Deeper in with excellent explanations.
You did not relapse by accident, you scheduled it and blamed Tuesday.
Familiar is comfortable and comfort is the whole cell.
The way out is memorised. The way back in has better lighting.
The chain does not glitter anymore. You just kept the habit of polishing it.

up: Some friends are weather-dependent and check the forecast before calling.
Who brings soup, as opposed to who brings opinions. That list.
Effort is the only audit that matters in the end.
Half the calendar likes you and a quarter of it shows up.
The easy fair weathers, the real ones stay for the bad venue.
Count the arrivals, not the replies.
Reevaluate the shallow end. It is shallow and you keep swimming there.
Loyalty is a logistics question, mostly, and an attendance one.
rev: Plot twist standing in the hallway, holding its own umbrella.
You went quiet on somebody in trouble and nobody graded it.
Check the mirror for fair weather before billing the whole roster.
Someone else is doing your vanishing act and enjoying it.
The role of the unreliable one has been quietly reassigned to you.
You cancelled on the hard week too, once or twice, allegedly never.
Being that friend is an invitation to stop being it.
Umbrella check before judgement, please.

up: Something wobbly finally lands, expensively, usefully.
The collapse is the news and also the renovation.
What fell was already leaning for years, smiling.
Rubble is an unglamorous foundation, but the materials are free.
The ground shifted and the good part is only visible from here.
Sudden is a scheduling habit of the inevitable.
Away with the unstable, in with the room it frees.
Down is a direction with a basement flat in it. Move in, briefly.
rev: You are propping up something that wants to be rubble. Do it properly or let go.
The crack you keep painting is load bearing.
Demolish it yourself. The paperwork is easier and the light better.
Postponing is expensive. The scaffolding bills weekly.
The lightning is patient. The suspense is self-inflicted.
Waiting for the fall is its own small building.
Controlled demolition, said the lightning, unimpressed.
You have decorated the crack. It remains a crack.

up: Somewhere between the facts and the feeling, a script. Check the author.
Not everything loud is large, and this one is not.
The crisis is a story and the story is running long.
Shrink the telling and see what remains. Usually a fine week.
Some weather is just weather, including yours tonight.
Catastrophe, checked twice, is usually inconvenience with a better agent.
You have told this one often enough for it to have a fan club.
Feel it fully, size it honestly, in that order.
rev: A real thing got waved off as a fuss once too often.
Suppressed feelings plan coupes quietly, on notice, with calendars.
Nobody believed the boy, ironically, once it counted.
Some drama is honest data delivered at volume. Turn down the volume, keep the data.
The calm performance is now a leak, not a wall.
A little theatre occasionally lets one true line through.
You have been the quiet one long enough for the plumbing to develop opinions.
Fuss denied, fuss accrued, the accountant arrives Tuesday.

up: Watch it go with genuine interest, the way you watch weather leave a day early.
Some things stopped deserving the expensive thing you spend daily.
Let it fly. Wave mildly. Return inside.
The energy was never allocated to the right building.
Boundaries look like this: not tonight, not this, not ever again.
You can stop maintaining the unmaintainable and keep the afternoon.
Some things have earned nothing from you for months. Confirm the invoice.
Release one thing with your whole hand and feel the difference.
rev: Gone too quickly, the useful kind of heavy, and you felt it land.
Caring loudly about not caring is still a caring budget.
Spite is care in a mask, and the mask is you.
You dropped the right bag and kept the receipt.
Moved on at speed, still orbiting at distance.
Some things deserved a second Tuesday, not a lifetime.
Watch it go, then check who is still standing at the window.
Energy spent proving indifference is a very expensive shrug.

up: Lie down like it is a skill and not a failure state.
Your body filed the request weeks ago. Approve it.
Rest is load bearing. The project survives an afternoon.
The horizontal hour outperforms the heroic evening.
Sleep is the boring medicine and you have been underdosing.
Stop earning the afternoon. Take it, unqualified.
One day off is maintenance, not mutiny.
The to-do list is a poor physician.
rev: Resting turned into vanishing and the vanishing stopped healing.
The bed became a strategy that only avoids.
Tired after eleven hours is a different tired with a different answer.
Get up, water, one small honest task, then reassess heroically.
Sleep as curtain, not cure. Open the other things.
The hiding is comfortable and the comfort is the trap.
You are not resting, you are buffering, and nothing is loading.
Horizontal is a posture, not a plan, past a certain Tuesday.

up: Some wheels spin with your name on nothing at all. Play anyway.
Timing and luck are not yours; the hand still is.
A system decides several things daily. Your job is the small honest part.
Luck turns quietly, mostly unannounced, occasionally kindly.
Being passed over is sometimes the wheel avoiding a puddle.
Do your bit, spin the rest, refuse the commentary.
What you cannot steer, do not staff.
The machine is not late. The machine is not early either.
rev: The weather has been taking it personally, and the weather is you.
Refresh once for news, four times for a verdict, and the verdict is anxiety.
The wheel was never aimed at you, though you have been apologising to it.
You read a sign into the bus timetable. It was a bus.
Superstition is optimism with strict routing.
That was randomness doing random things, and you filed it as feedback.
Unlucky is not the same as unwanted, and you have confused the forms.
Stop taking the tide personally. It is the moon's schedule.

up: Someone else did the arithmetic and the answer is finally consequences.
Evidence is quiet and it wins loudly, eventually.
What was done stands, paper trail or none. Yours is standing.
The record is unemotional and, today, on your side.
A fair outcome, rare as birds, and this one has your name on it.
Told you, gently, with documentation.
Truth weighs the same in every currency, which is why it settles.
The weighing happens whether you attend or not. Attend, smugly, briefly.
rev: The score is kept in a war your public statement denies.
Screenshots are not intimacy, though they make excellent armour.
You want to be correct more than you want the evening. Check the exchange rate.
Winning the argument, again, at the friend's expense.
Being proved right, left alone with it, is a specific cold room.
Reconciliation was on the table under the exhibits.
Some ledgers forgive nothing, including the keeper.
The file on them is thick and the file on the friendship is thinner.

up: Nobody asked you to sign, and you are living in the terms anyway.
Somebody else wrote the lease on your week. Read it before renewing.
The rules exist, the rent is due, and one of these two is negotiable.
An authority is anywhere the terms live. Check whose signature is on yours.
The parent, the boss, the platform: pick your rent-collector, it helps.
Terms apply, including to you, especially the invisible clause.
You did not write this contract and you keep enforcing it.
Pay what is owed, inspect what is invented.
rev: The tight hand is yours, and the order it keeps is starting to tremble.
Petty rules are just control with worse handwriting.
You would rather be right by the letter than decent by the spirit.
Compromise is not the collapse of order, whatever the rulebook says.
An authority that never bends is just a wobble with denial.
You are making everyone pay your rent for the same corridor.
The rent-collector is also inside and also behind a door.
Order for its own sake is tidy and nobody invited.

up: Nothing is happening and that is the schedule, not the verdict.
The pause is part of the treatment, annoyingly, professionally.
Hold still, an unglamorous skill, the results are on a slow server.
Some weeks contain zero events and one decision not to panic.
The queue is long and, today, not personal.
Nothing moved is a state, not a sentence.
Waiting has a posture and yours is improving.
Today is the corridor before the room. Corridors are fine.
rev: You have stood in that line so long you bought furniture.
Stalling has been promoted to patience and the promotion is bogus.
The permission was never coming. The paperwork was you.
You could leave the queue right now. There is no law, only habit and biscuits.
Waiting for them, or waiting instead of doing. Be precise, briefly, honestly.
Procrastination in a queue still smells like the queue.
The number was called twice. You were at the window for a different desk.
Martyring quietly, in a chair, on purpose, unpaid.

up: Low heat, long hours, and the result is not available on express.
What takes months cannot be persuaded by a deadline. Feed it weekly.
The slow version is the version that stays done.
Physio, savings, fluency: all three run on the same boring engine.
Do the twelve minutes properly and let the months do their unimpressed work.
Rush is a seasoning it does not need.
Heat low, hands off, check back in April.
Time is not the enemy, it is the appliance.
rev: You turned the dial up and the middle stayed raw.
Finished early, unfinished entirely, the two most common lies.
Quitting the course in week two is just impatience with better filing.
Nothing bad happened, it just took as long as it said.
Forcing a slow thing produces a fast failure.
You wanted Tuesday's result by Friday and the pot is not negotiable.
Simmering is the skill. You have been boiling for morale.
The middle of it is where it cooks. You keep lifting the lid.

up: Say the small plain thing with no buts in it.
Repair is a sentence, not a strategy, and you know the sentence.
No conditions, no exhibits, no gently. Just the words.
Owe it cleanly or accept it plainly, the two adult moves.
Saying it costs the pride and buys the room back.
Forgiveness starts when the defence stops presenting.
Plain words, unlawyered, land first time.
Say it badly if you must. Conditional ones never land at all.
rev: Sorry you feel that way, a sentence that closes doors politely.
That was an exit wearing a nice phrase.
You apologised to end the conversation, and it ended the conversation.
Being forgiven too early is its own small pressure.
The weak one arrived with a timeline and no accounting.
Some sorrys are doorbells rung to run.
You accepted the weak one because the alternative was more silence.
Forgiveness, signed without reading, at someone else's speed.
